rounds: Two weeks of going through the motions — routine locked in, which is actually a win even when it doesn't feel like one. But the Apollo ring moment? That one went to the Joy Police. Colleague asked a direct question and you folded the whole conversation up and put it away.
pattern: They're fine with the accessories as long as nobody asks about them.
focus: One real answer. Next time someone notices something — the ring, the nail polish, anything — give them one true sentence instead of the exit.
